#Load libraries
```{r}

library('ggplot2')
library('plyr')
library('dplyr')
library('ez')
library('tidyr')
library('Rmisc')
library('lme4')
library('lmerTest')
library('car')

```

#Exp 1

## Load data
```{r}

# Set wd
setwd()   # Add relevant directory

exp1.data <- read.csv('Exp1_TargetNotes.csv')
exp1.data$dwelltime <- as.numeric(as.character(exp1.data$dwelltime))


```


## Run ezanova
```{r}
exp1.by.subj <- ddply(exp1.data, c("subjID","entropy.status","phrase.status"),summarise,dwelltime=mean(dwelltime))

exp1.anova <- ezANOVA(data=exp1.by.subj, dv=.(dwelltime),wid=.(subjID),within=.(entropy.status,phrase.status),return_aov = TRUE)

exp1.anova

```

## Supplemental mixed effects models

```{r}

exp1.data$entropy.status.recode <-ifelse(exp1.data$entropy.status=='high', 1, -1)
exp1.data$phrase.status.recode <-ifelse(exp1.data$phrase.status=='end', 1, -1)


library(glmmTMB)

#Model with raw data
full.model <- glmmTMB(dwelltime ~ entropy.status.recode * phrase.status.recode + par.note.id +stim.order+(1|subjID)+(1|stim.name),data= exp1.data)

summary(full.model)

#Model with log data
exp1.data$logDT <- log(exp1.data$dwelltime)

#model
log.model <- glmmTMB(logDT ~ entropy.status.recode * phrase.status.recode + par.note.id +stim.order+(1|subjID)+(1|stim.name),data= exp1.data)

summary(log.model)

#Model with gamma distribution
gamma.model <- glmmTMB(dwelltime ~ entropy.status.recode * phrase.status.recode + par.note.id +stim.order+(1|subjID)+(1|stim.name),data= exp1.data, family=Gamma(link="log"))

summary(gamma.model)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}


#get avgs and within-subject confidence intervals
dwelltime_norm <- normDataWithin(data=exp1.by.subj, idvar="subjID", measurevar="dwelltime")

wsebs <- ddply(dwelltime_norm, c("phrase.status","entropy.status"), summarise, N = n_distinct(subjID), mean = mean(dwelltimeNormed), sd=sd(dwelltimeNormed), se=sd/sqrt(N), ci=qnorm(.975)*sd/sqrt(N))

setwd()     # Add relevant directory
all.exp1 <- read.csv('Exp1_AllNotes.csv')
nontargs <- subset(all.exp1,target.status=="n")
nontarget.long <- gather(nontargs, subjID, dwelltime, DTS01_v1_NoOut:DTS38_NoOut, factor_key=TRUE)
nontarg.complete <- nontarget.long[!is.na(nontarget.long$dwelltime), ]
nontarg.complete$dwelltime <- as.numeric(as.character(nontarg.complete$dwelltime))

val <- mean(nontarg.complete$dwelltime,na.rm=T)

#plot 
fig2.plot <- ggplot()+
  geom_point(data=exp1.by.subj, aes(x = interaction(entropy.status,phrase.status), y=dwelltime, 
                                 group=interaction(phrase.status,subjID), 
                                 shape=factor(entropy.status),size=3.5),colour="grey88")+
  geom_line(data=exp1.by.subj, aes(x = interaction(entropy.status,phrase.status), y=dwelltime,
                  group=interaction(phrase.status,subjID),shape=factor(entropy.status),size=1),colour="grey88")+
  geom_point(data=wsebs,
             aes(x=interaction(entropy.status,phrase.status),y=mean,shape=factor(entropy.status),size=9),

  scale_shape_manual(values=c(16, 1),
                     name="Entropy",
                     breaks=c("high","low"),
                     labels=c("High", "Low"))+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold",size=18),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size=14))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold",size=18),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size=14))+
  theme(legend.title=element_text(face="bold",size=18))+
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=14))+
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(val), linetype="dotted")

fig2.plot

```


##Correlations with GMSI
```{r}

sep.by.entropy <- ddply(exp1.data, c("subjID","entropy.status"),summarise,dwelltime=mean(dwelltime))
dt.effect <- spread(sep.by.entropy,entropy.status,dwelltime)

# Import GMSI scores
setwd()
gmsi.all <- read.csv('GMSI_Exp1_Exp2.csv')
gmsi.exp1 <- subset(gmsi.all, Experiment == "Exp1")
gmsi.order <- gmsi.exp1[order(gmsi.exp1$SubjID),]

# Bind dwell time data and GMSI scores 
dt.gmsi <- cbind(dt.effect,gmsi.order)

# Get entropy effect magnitude
dt.gmsi$dwell.effect <- dt.gmsi$high-dt.gmsi$low

# Correlations
cor.test(dt.gmsi$dwell.effect,dt.gmsi$General,method="pearson")
cor.test(dt.gmsi$dwell.effect,dt.gmsi$MusicTraining,method="pearson")
cor.test(dt.gmsi$dwell.effect,dt.gmsi$ActiveEngagement, method="pearson")

```


# All tones analysis

```{r}

# Prepare data 
data <- gather(all.exp1, subjID, dwelltime, DTS01_v1_NoOut:DTS38_NoOut, factor_key=TRUE)
data$dwelltimelog <- log10(data$dwelltime)

# Model 1: Null model with only note id 
null.model = lmer(dwelltimelog ~ par.note.id + (par.note.id|subjID), data=data, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e8)))
Anova(null.model)

# Model 2: Only IC
IC.model = lmer(dwelltimelog ~ par.note.id + stim.IC + (par.note.id|subjID), data=data, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e8)))
Anova(IC.model)

# Model 3: IC and entropy
entropy.IC.model = lmer(dwelltimelog ~ par.note.id + stim.IC + stim.entropy.next + (par.note.id|subjID), data=data, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e8)))
Anova(entropy.IC.model)

# Model comparison
anova(null.model,IC.model,entropy.IC.model) 
anova(entropy.IC.model)

```



# Exp 2
## Load data

```{r}

# Set wd
setwd()   # Add relevant directory
exp2.data <- read.csv('Exp2_Data.csv')


```

## Clean data
```{r}

exp2.data$ratings <- as.numeric(as.character(exp2.data$ratings))


# Omit 5 participants with uninterpretable data
exp2.data <- subset(exp2.data, subjID!="compRater_S03")
exp2.data <- subset(exp2.data, subjID!="compRater_S11")
exp2.data <- subset(exp2.data, subjID!="compRater_24")
exp2.data <- subset(exp2.data, subjID!="compRater_S10")
exp2.data <- subset(exp2.data, subjID!="compRater_S29")

```

##Run ezanova

```{r}

exp2.by.subj <- ddply(exp2.data, c("subjID","entropy","position"),summarise,
                      ratings=mean(ratings,na.rm=TRUE))

exp2.anova <- ezANOVA(data=exp2.by.subj, dv=.(ratings),wid=.(subjID),within=.(entropy,position),return_aov = TRUE)

exp2.anova


```


## Figure 3

```{r}

#get avgs and within-subject confidence intervals

comp.exp2 <- normDataWithin(data=exp2.by.subj, idvar="subjID", measurevar="ratings")

wsebs_exp2 <- ddply(comp.exp2, c("position","entropy"), summarise, N = n_distinct(subjID), mean = mean(ratingsNormed), sd=sd(ratingsNormed), se=sd/sqrt(N), ci=qnorm(0.975)*sd/sqrt(N))


fig3.plot <- ggplot()+
  geom_point(data=exp2.by.subj, aes(x = interaction(entropy,position), y=ratings, group=interaction(position,subjID),shape=factor(entropy),size=3.5),colour="grey88")+ #group=interaction(position,subjID),shape = factor(entropy)), size=5, color="grey")+
  # geom_point(aes(shape = factor(entropy)), size=5, color="grey")+
  geom_line(data=exp2.by.subj, aes(x = interaction(entropy,position), y=ratings, group=interaction(position,subjID),shape=factor(entropy),size=1),colour="grey88")+
  geom_point(data=wsebs_exp2, aes(x=interaction(entropy,position),y=mean,shape=factor(entropy),size=9),colour="black")+
  geom_errorbar(data=wsebs_exp2,aes(x=interaction(entropy,position),y=mean,ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),width=.1) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,7),breaks=c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7))+
  ylab("Completeness ratings") +
  xlab("Boundary status")+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(16, 1),
                     name="Entropy",
                     breaks=c("hi","lo"),
                     labels=c("High", "Low"))+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold",size=18),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size=14))+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold",size=18),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size=14))+
  theme(legend.title=element_text(face="bold",size=18))+
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=14))

fig3.plot
```

##Correlations with GMSI
```{r}

sep.by.entropy.2 <- ddply(exp2.data, c("subjID","entropy"),summarise,ratings=mean(ratings))
comp.effect <- spread(sep.by.entropy.2,entropy,ratings)

# Import GMSI scores
setwd() # Add relevant directory
gmsi.all <- read.csv('GMSI_Exp1_Exp2.csv')
gmsi.exp2 <- subset(gmsi.all, Experiment == "Exp2")
gmsi.order.2 <- gmsi.exp2[order(gmsi.exp2$SubjID),]


# Omit 5 participants with uninterpretable completeness rating data
gmsi.order.2 <- subset(gmsi.order.2, SubjID !="compRater_S03")
gmsi.order.2 <- subset(gmsi.order.2, SubjID !="compRater_S11")
gmsi.order.2 <- subset(gmsi.order.2, SubjID !="compRater_S24")
gmsi.order.2 <- subset(gmsi.order.2, SubjID !="compRater_S10")
gmsi.order.2 <- subset(gmsi.order.2, SubjID !="compRater_S29")

# Bind dwell time data and GMSI scores 
comp.gmsi <- cbind(comp.effect,gmsi.order.2)

# Get entropy effect magnitude
comp.gmsi$ratings.effect <- comp.gmsi$hi-comp.gmsi$lo

# Correlations
cor.test(comp.gmsi$ratings.effect,comp.gmsi$General,method="pearson")
cor.test(comp.gmsi$ratings.effect,comp.gmsi$MusicTraining,method="pearson")
cor.test(comp.gmsi$ratings.effect,comp.gmsi$ActiveEngagement, method="pearson")

```
